issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-I change request from STU3 asking to replace GET [base]/Encounter?length=gt20 as an invalid number-search example because Encounter.length had become a quantity search parameter.
initial_application: The Jira comment records application in svn revision 14258. No current git commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-17436 was found. The present source/search.html number-search section uses other examples and no Encounter.length number-search example remains.
additional_context: FHIR-13020 established the same change family by changing Encounter.length search from number to quantity. The current active Encounter search parameter remains quantity. FHIR-22765 later retained Encounter.length as an actual Duration element rather than removing it.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the stale Encounter.length number-search documentation example is absent and the active Encounter-length search parameter is quantity.
